content: AI inspection report generation for oil/gas mechanical integrity is dominated by enterprise CIM/data platforms rather than copilots for inspectors; gap exists for an inspector-facing acceptance-evaluation copilot. Spectora AI Report Assist (home inspection) turns voice+photos into report comments in the inspector's style, ~25% faster reporting; InspectorData converts photos to reports with 8,000 pre-built comment lines; NACHI forum reports one-button 60-second AI reports. Pattern proves AI-writes-the-report UX wins in adjacent markets without code acceptance math.
